description: This file defines the ViewsUIController class for Drupal, handling routes related to Views UI, including reporting fields, plugins, performing AJAX operations, autocompletion for tags, and editing views.

classes.name: ViewsUIController
classes.description: Controller class for handling Views UI related routes in Drupal, including reporting fields, plugins, AJAX operations, autocompletion, and editing views.

methods.name: reportFields
methods.description: Generates a report of all fields used in Views, listing field names and associated views.

methods.name: reportPlugins
methods.description: Generates a report of all view plugins and the views that use them.

methods.name: ajaxOperation
methods.description: Performs an operation (enable/disable) on a view and returns an AJAX response or redirects.

methods.name: autocompleteTag
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for view tags based on a query string.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Returns forms to edit and preview a specific view.
